{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].dtype != 'object':
    data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].astype(str)
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == 999999.99
filtered_data = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter out refunded orders
refunded_mask = filtered_data['status'] == 'refunded'
completed_data = filtered_data[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = completed_data.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()

# Print results
print(f'Conversion rates by segment (in %):
{conversion_rate.round(2)}')
print(f'Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}')"}
